requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Compare every visible shoe with the supplied side, top and three-quarter references. Silhouette, panel construction, mesh, sole geometry and markings must remain those of the referenced model, with an off-white upper and orange sole accent corresponding to the specified colours. Allow perspective, occlusion and photographic illumination; fail substituted models, invented construction or markings, or materially changed base colours. Do not require individual photographed pixels to equal the hexadecimal values.

Alex must be recognisable as the person in alex-lane.png and retain the reference garments and their visible characteristics. Changes in pose, expression, camera angle and natural garment folds are allowed; a different person or replacement outfit fails.

Compare Morgan with morgan-reed.png and the Morgan casting record: medium-brown skin, short tightly curled dark hair, a clean-shaven face, average build, sage #798777 crew-neck T-shirt, charcoal #303236 running shorts, white ankle socks and a plain black watch on the left wrist. Preserve visible identity, wardrobe and accessory details, allowing photographic colour shifts and pose-dependent occlusion. Do not infer an exact age or handedness from appearance alone.

The final photographs and crops must present a coherent first-hour-after-sunrise treatment: low directional sunlight, plausible long shadows, controlled fill and a consistent colour balance compatible with the stated lighting setup. Use morning-light-plan.png and dawn-street.png as lighting and atmosphere evidence. Allow changes caused by camera orientation and subject position; fail contradictory light directions within a scene, midday or night treatment, or conspicuously inconsistent contrast and colour balance. Exact compass bearing, elapsed time, ratio and Kelvin setting cannot be established from pixels alone.

Match the scene records: S01 shows Alex standing and warming up on pavement; S02 shows Morgan climbing station steps at an easy pace; S03 shows Alex running easily along a canal path. Allow photographic framing and city details to vary while preserving each assigned person, setting and activity. S01 must function as the landscape advertisement.

P01 must contain the complete matching pair on pavement in three-quarter view, occupying at least 80% of the image width across the pair. D01 must make the mesh-to-sole interface inspectable, and D02 must clearly reveal both lacing and tongue construction. Allow framing and depth-of-field choices that preserve the required evidence; clipping the hero shoes or obscuring the named details fails.

Verify one underlying S01 exposure across landscape 3:2, square 1:1 and vertical 9:16 compositions by matching pose, scene details and lighting. Allow crop, scale and graphic placement changes; regenerated or different photographic moments fail. Every image must include the exact brand name, campaign line and unchanged black reference mark. Following campaign-safe-zones.png, copy must be wholly in the upper quarter, while faces, both complete shoes, copy and mark must be wholly within the 8% edge inset.

The boards must communicate identifiable A, B and C alternatives and make action, camera position and the runner's relationship to the city comparable. Allow different board layouts and explanatory text; relabelled duplicates or differences limited to superficial colour or typography fail.

The sheet must identify exactly one supplied direction by letter, explain why it was chosen and provide usable shot records for the applicable commission. Records must associate shot IDs with proportions, camera positions, subjects and intended uses, matching the assigned scene and product records. It must state both shoe colour specifications, the prescribed lighting treatment and the exact brand name and campaign line. Allow prose, tables or diagrams; missing fields, contradictory assignments or an unidentifiable selection fail.

Read the sheet's required camera-position records against the supplied plan and fact sheet. The plan uses a southwest origin in an east-west 12000 mm by north-south 8000 mm area, with subject at east 6000/north 4000 mm, camera at east 6000/north 1500 mm, reflector at east 4000/north 6000 mm and flag at east 2000/north 4000 mm. Equivalent units or a clearly equivalent coordinate representation are allowed. Camera records or any reproduced setup geometry that contradict the supplied plan fail; the sheet need not reproduce every plan annotation.

The documented development sequence must place the three alternatives before the selected shooting plan. The sheet must name one of A, B or C, and presentation page 1 must explicitly name that same letter. Allow any selection and page design; missing, ambiguous or conflicting selection labels fail. Assess the documented sequence without inventing requirements for timestamps.

Identify the selected board from the shooting sheet, then compare the finished stills with its action, camera approach and treatment of the city. Runner images, product images and advertisements must visibly develop the selected direction where applicable. Allow execution refinements and the mandated different shots; switching to an unselected concept or producing unrelated visual approaches fails.

Verify that the sheet explicitly records both hexadecimal colours, southeast illumination at approximately 20 degrees elevation, capture within the first 60 minutes after sunrise, a 4:1 key-to-fill ratio and 5200 K white balance. The presentation must repeat those values adjacent to relevant finished images, and sequence captions must preserve the sheet's shot-ID-to-proportion associations. Equivalent notation and reasonable wording of the approximate elevation are allowed; omitted values, contradictions, misplaced facts without relevant image association or mismatched captions fail.

Review the complete video and its duration. It must run for 10 seconds, allowing only frame-rounding tolerance, and progress from Alex preparing to Morgan running before finishing on a product frame. Throughout, preserve both runners' reference identities and clothing, every visible shoe's reference model, colours and markings, the prescribed morning treatment and the selected concept. The final frame must visibly contain the existing black mark and the exact two copy lines. Apply the stated upper-quarter copy placement and 8% advertising inset to protected content when present. If the end frame is a whole-product photograph, its complete pair must span at least 80% of the frame width. Editorial transitions may vary; wrong sequencing, substituted identities or product, missing end-frame content or materially wrong duration fail.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation must visibly reuse each concept board, the selected shooting sheet, every delivered finished photograph and advertising crop, and identifiable stills from the delivered video. Resizing, page-layout changes and legible excerpts of the sheet are acceptable when the source remains identifiable. Substituted imagery, merely naming an asset, or omitting any source fails.

The presentation must have at least eight pages and an identifiable campaign image sequence progressing through preparation, running, recovery and product in that order. Concepts and planning pages may sit outside that sequence, and multiple images may share a page. Recovery must be represented in the sequence without requiring an additional separately exported still. Fewer pages, a missing phase or an incorrectly ordered campaign sequence fails.

Runner photographs and advertisements develop the selected shooting direction and its documented lighting treatment. The S01 family uses one exposure with a consistent mark and copy treatment across landscape, square and vertical compositions. Runner identities, clothing, shoe construction and advertising protected areas comply with the supplied campaign facts.

The hero and detail photographs continue the selected direction, shoe identity and morning light established by the shooting sheet and runner campaign. The product group supplies the complete three-quarter pair and distinct, inspectable mesh junction and lacing-and-tongue details.
